body:
Triage: promoted to **Bug**, `pm:queue`, routed `domain:engine`. Rationale: two executors answer the same aggregate over the same rows differently, and the divergence is user-visible (a dashboard tile renders a rate on SQLite and a blank on driver-memory, indistinguishable from "no rows") and test-corrupting (in-memory suites assert against `null` and cannot fail in the direction that matters). The measurement isolates the cell precisely: boolean *filtering* agrees, derived ratios agree, only `avg` over a boolean diverges — and SQLite's numbers are the arithmetically correct ones. Dispatch is diagnose-first: locate where the divergence lives (driver-memory's aggregate, the ObjectQL aggregate bridge, or a deliberate non-numeric refusal). Mechanism assumption to verify: align driver-memory to numeric coercion of booleans (0/1) matching the SQL arm; if the divergence turns out to be a deliberate refusal to average non-numerics, the two faces must still agree — and a loud refusal on both beats `null` on one (the card says the same). Reproduction is already packaged in the hotcrm two-driver harness the card names. Size S. Related closed cells #6814/#6815 are precedent that these get fixed as consistency bugs.

Serial constraints cleared: in-flight sibling **#11009** holds `packages/metadata-core` + **`packages/objectql`** + `packages/drivers/driver-sql` + `packages/services/service-messaging`. This card's surface is `packages/drivers/driver-memory` — disjoint from all four. **`packages/objectql` is the near miss and the reason for the ⛔ boundary below.** PR **#11139** holds `packages/metadata-protocol`. Lane in-flight at claim: 1.

## Premise verified on `origin/main` @ `acb4dbc09` — and it collapses triage's three-way diagnosis to one

Triage dispatched this diagnose-first: *"locate where the divergence lives (driver-memory's aggregate, the ObjectQL aggregate bridge, or a deliberate non-numeric refusal)"*. That read is answered before dispatch, because the answer changes both the file surface and the tier. **There are three in-memory-or-SQL implementations of `avg` in this repo, and they do not two-way disagree — driver-memory is the lone outlier:**

| implementation | expression | `avg` over a boolean column |
|:--|:--|:--|
| SQLite (`SqliteWasmDriver`) | `AVG(col)` | `0.4` / `0.25` — the card's measured, arithmetically correct numbers |
| **`packages/objectql/src/in-memory-aggregation.ts:219`** | `values.filter(v => v != null).map(toNumber)` | **already correct** — `toNumber` (`:255`) is `Number(v)` gated on `Number.isFinite`, so `Number(true) === 1` |
| **`packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-driver.ts:1246`** | `values.filter(v => typeof v === 'number')` | **`null`** — every boolean is filtered out, `nums.length === 0`, and the arm returns `null` |

```js
// memory-driver.ts:1245 — the defect, verbatim
case 'sum':
case 'avg': {
    const nums = values.filter(v => typeof v === 'number');
    const sum = nums.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    if (func === 'sum') return sum;
    return nums.length > 0 ? sum / nums.length : null;
}
```

That is the card's symptom exactly, including why the two controls agreed: boolean *filtering* never passes through this arm, and the `derived` ratio is computed from `count` measures, whose arm counts `!= null` rather than `typeof === 'number'`.

### The refusal branch is dead — do not spend time on it

Triage's third possibility (*"a deliberate refusal to average a non-numeric column"*) and the card's own fallback position (*"a loud refusal would be more useful than `null`"*) are both **foreclosed by the table above**: this repo's *other* in-memory averaging path already coerces booleans and answers the SQL number. A refusal would have to break `in-memory-aggregation.ts` too, and *that* would be a contract change needing its own ruling. So the fix direction is settled and narrow: **align driver-memory to the two implementations that already agree.**

⚠️ `sum` shares the same `values.filter(...)` line. Aligning `avg` without deciding `sum` leaves the same defect one arm over (`sum` over a boolean = "how many true", `0` today). Decide it deliberately and say which you chose and why — do not leave it unexamined.

## ⛔ Boundaries

1. **⛔ Do not edit `packages/objectql`.** It is held by in-flight #11009 (same package, `engine.ts`). `in-memory-aggregation.ts` is the *reference* implementation here, not a work item — read it, match its answer, **do not import from it** (that would add a cross-package dependency this card has no mandate for) and do not refactor the two into one.
2. **⛔ Do not adopt `toNumber`'s wider behaviour.** It maps a non-numeric *string* to `0`, silently averaging garbage as zero. Whether that is right is a separate question this card does not open. Fix the **boolean** case.
3. If `memory-analytics.ts`'s mingo `$avg` path proves to carry the same divergence, it is **in this package and in scope** — fix both faces or say why only one.
4. Any *other* driver found sharing the defect ⇒ report it, ⛔ do not fix it here.

## Acceptance

A regression pin that fails in the direction that matters — the card's own reason for existing is that an in-memory suite asserting `null` *cannot* fail correctly. Pin the card's measured shape: 5 rows, 4 closed, `avg` over `is_sla_violated` ⇒ `0.4` unfiltered and `0.25` under the closed filter, on driver-memory. Include the reversing/positive control the card's own method used (a `count` measure over the same rows) so a driver that stopped aggregating entirely does not keep it green.

## ⚠️ Freeze interaction — recorded, not waved

This card's fix lands in `driver-memory`, which is under the maintainer's 2026-08-05 investment freeze (cross-issue anchor **#5499**). That anchor's standing triage rule would normally send this card straight to `pm:on-hold`:

> **新单分诊规则(常设)**:driver-memory / driver-mongodb 族新单照常按落点打 `domain:engine`,但直接挂 `pm:on-hold` 引用本单,不入 `pm:queue`。

It is dispatched anyway because the same ruling carries an explicit exception whose premise this card states in its own body:

> **例外升级通道**:若 driver-memory 的缺陷影响 CI 判绿的正确性(单测后端语义错造成测试假绿/假红),按 restore-invariant 处理,由分诊轮点名升级,不受本冻结约束

The card's third section is that exception, in the reporter's words: *"a suite that pins a rate measure on the in-memory driver asserts against `null` and cannot fail in the direction that matters. That is how I hit it — an assertion written against the violation rate passed on SQLite and read `null` on memory."* Triage promoted it to `Bug` + `pm:queue` in a triage round on exactly that rationale (*"test-corrupting"*), which is the 「由分诊轮点名升级」 the exception requires — though it did not cite #5499, which is why this seat is writing the interaction down rather than letting a merge into a frozen package read later as freeze erosion. **Scope stays restore-invariant**: align one arm to the two faces that already agree. ⛔ No other driver-memory investment rides along.

## ACCEPT — PR #11153, 31/31 checks green, enqueued

Verified by name rather than by aggregate: `mergeable_state: clean`, 31 check runs, `Lint & Repo Gates` green, `Console Pin Gate` **skipped** not red. Flipped to ready, auto-merge enabled.

Three things this dispatch did better than it was asked to:

1. **The face was traced, not grepped.** The dispatch asked which of two faces the repro reaches; the answer came back as instrumented output showing `driver.aggregate → performAggregation → computeAggregate` on a non-array `DriverQuery`, with the single `driver.find` correctly identified as the insert path. That is the difference between a reading and a guess, and this lane has paid for the difference before.
2. **The second face was measured independently.** I flagged `memory-analytics.ts` as *possible* scope; the dev settled it against mingo 7.2.4 directly (`$avg → null`, `$sum → 0` over five booleans, with a numeric control). Fixing only the data face would have left the analytics face free to keep its own answer — the exact shape #6814 recorded on `count_distinct`. The reasoning for carrying the rule as a `$group` expression rather than post-processing (the `count_distinct` neighbour's post-step runs *after* `$sort`/`$limit`, and ordering by a `sum`/`avg` measure is an ordinary query) is a real trap avoided.
3. **`sum` was decided rather than left.** The dispatch asked for a deliberate decision; the answer — coerce it too, because `0` is a plausible-looking wrong number where `null` is at least a visible hole — is the right call and is argued rather than asserted.

The reverse verification is the standard I want in this lane: direction **predicted before running** (10 of 15 failing, all on values rather than throws), measured **11**, and the miss recorded in the test docblock instead of the prediction being quietly rewritten to match. Also correctly established that no build stands between pin and mutation (the test imports by relative path, and the stale `dist/` built from `origin/main` would have made the unmutated run impossible to pass) — that is the `dist/` false-green this seat has on its platform-facts list, checked rather than assumed.

### ⛔ A correction to MY freeze reasoning, prompted by the dev's finding

I dispatched this into a frozen package on #5499's exception clause and justified it with **假绿** — a suite asserting `null` that cannot fail in the direction that matters. The dev's measurement refines that: **nothing in this repo pinned the old `null`.** The full package suite was green before and after. The false-green the reporter hit was in *hotcrm's* suite, not ours.

What is true in-repo is **structural blindness**, which the dev filed as **#11152**: the shared cross-driver fixture `AGGREGATION_ROWS` carries **no boolean column at all**, so the aggregation-conformance family cannot see this cell on any driver.

The exception still holds — a conformance family that cannot observe a cell impairs CI's ability to judge correctly just as surely as a wrong pin does, and arguably more quietly. But the **form** I asserted was not the form that was there, and I asserted it without checking. Recorded here rather than left standing, because a freeze exception invoked on a mis-stated premise is exactly how a freeze erodes.

### Out-of-scope, filed and labelled

**#11151** (`driver-mongodb` lowers `avg`/`sum` as bare `$avg`/`$sum` — the same cell one driver over) and **#11152** (the fixture blindness, plus `min`/`max` over booleans as a genuinely unsettled cell). Both verified present; #11151 was filed bare and now carries `finding`. ⛔ Note for triage: #11151 lands in `driver-mongodb`, which is **also** under the #5499 freeze — and unlike this card it has no test-truth argument to ride the exception, so the default `pm:on-hold` route likely applies. Correctly filed rather than fixed.
